description: Enhanced Pydantic model for Identity Card Schema

surname.description: Surname (family name) of the cardholder as stated on the card.
surname.title: Surname

given_names.description: Given names of the cardholder as stated on the card.
given_names.title: Given Names

sex.description: Sex of the cardholder, represented as M (Male), F (Female)
sex.title: Sex

nationality.description: Nationality of the cardholder, typically as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code.
nationality.title: Nationality

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth of the cardholder, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.
date_of_birth.title: Date Of Birth

place_of_birth.description: Place of birth of the cardholder, typically city and/or country.
place_of_birth.title: Place Of Birth

alternate_name.description: Alternate or maiden name of the cardholder, if applicable.
alternate_name.title: Alternate Name

signature.description: Transcription or description of the cardholder's signature, if available.
signature.title: Signature

document_number.description: Unique document number of the identity card.
document_number.title: Document Number

date_of_issue.description: Issue date of the identity card, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.
date_of_issue.title: Date Of Issue

date_of_expiry.description: Expiry date of the identity card, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.
date_of_expiry.title: Date Of Expiry

issuing_authority.description: Authority that issued the identity card.
issuing_authority.title: Issuing Authority

security_features.description: Notes about visible security features such as holograms or watermarks.
security_features.title: Security Features

extraction_notes.description: Additional notes regarding uncertainties or discrepancies during extraction.
extraction_notes.title: Extraction Notes

title: IdentityCard
